project_operating_context.mission: Build maintainable software whose externally observable behavior is defined by a Markdown specification, implemented with behavior-focused test-driven development, verified end to end where applicable, and documented for end users in a portable offline HTML guide.

interaction_policy.clarify_when: Ask focused questions before implementation when ambiguity could materially change observable behavior, public interfaces, data semantics, compatibility, security, acceptance criteria, or user experience.
interaction_policy.do_not_overask: Do not ask about minor implementation choices that can be safely selected without changing requested behavior. Use reasonable defaults and record important assumptions in the specification.

source_of_truth.specification: Define externally observable behavior, acceptance criteria, and behavior-defining test scenarios here before implementation.
source_of_truth.specification_quality: Before implementation, the specification must be precise enough to define observable acceptance behavior and must address applicable non-functional requirements, constraints, failure behavior, security, and compatibility or migration concerns. Irrelevant areas may be marked N/A with a reason.
source_of_truth.implementation: Production code must conform to the accepted specification. Internal design may change unless it is part of the public contract.

testing_contract.observable_behavior: Tests must prove observable outcomes, not merely that internal functions, methods, callbacks, or mocks were invoked. Prefer assertions on state, output, documented errors, persisted effects, protocol responses, or other contract-level outcomes.
testing_contract.interaction_assertions: Use interaction assertions only when the interaction itself is an explicit observable contract or no stronger outcome can reasonably be observed.
testing_contract.traceability: Every newly added behavior-defining automated test must map to a stable `TC-*` scenario recorded in the specification. Record scenario intent and expected observable outcome, not test-framework implementation details.
testing_contract.bug_regression: A behavior-affecting bug fix must be represented by a stable regression TC scenario and a test that fails for the reported behavioral defect before the production fix is written.
testing_contract.browser_e2e: Browser-visible acceptance behavior must be verifiable with Playwright Test. Prefer user-facing locators and explicit UI contracts over DOM structure or implementation selectors.

documentation_contract.portability: Zipping the entire docs/user-guide directory and sending it to another person must include everything needed to read the Markdown specification and use the HTML guide.
documentation_contract.offline: Core guide functionality must work without network access or a development server. Opening site/index.html directly with a file URL should work in modern desktop browsers.

features.language_switching: Provide at least Japanese and English.
features.search: Provide client-side search with no server dependency.
features.theme: Provide light and dark modes, honor system preference by default, and preserve explicit user preference when storage is available.
